items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: in Kansas City we had Baby Woods

ctx.x: He came from Alexandria. Well, I don't know what already dealt with him.

But he was playing with a band in Kansas City. And he told us, he said, listen, he and I, and Lucian Johnson, and a couple other boys in the band was together, and he said, don't y'all, we used to have all Ted Lewis arrangements, you know. He said, don't play nothing but the good old New Orleans jazz, which y'all really know how they play. They play high as a side, the Tiger Rags, the Sandler's Blues, you see, if y'all want to win this contest. And this band had some fine arrangements. I was enjoying that stuff,…
